import argparse, ast, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, secrets, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from native_evidence import run_native
p=argparse.ArgumentParser(); p.add_argument('--wheel',type=pathlib.Path,required=True); p.add_argument('--copilot',type=pathlib.Path,required=True); p.add_argument('--output',type=pathlib.Path,required=True); args=p.parse_args()
base=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='amkernel-external-install-')); project=base/'project'; project.mkdir(); env=dict(os.environ)
env.update({'UV_TOOL_DIR':str(base/'tools'),'UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR':str(base/'bin'),'AMKERNEL_DATA_HOME':str(base/'data'),'COPILOT_HOME':str(base/'copilot')})
env['PATH']=str(base/'bin')+os.pathsep+env['PATH']; args.output.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
evidence={'schemaVersion':1,'issue':105,'scope':'Clean installed wheel, external non-git project, native GitHub Copilot discovery and MCP','base':str(base),'project':str(project),'wheelSha256':hashlib.sha256(args.wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'checks':[],'commands':[]}
def scrub(text):
 token = env.get('COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN')
 if token: text = text.replace(token, '[REDACTED_TOKEN]')
 return text.replace(str(base),'$TEMP_ROOT').replace(str(pathlib.Path.home()),'$HOME')
def run(cmd,*,timeout=180,expected=0):
 r=subprocess.run(list(map(str,cmd)),cwd=project,env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=timeout)
 evidence['commands'].append({'argv':list(map(str,cmd)),'cwd':str(project),'exit':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout[-30000:],'stderr':r.stderr[-5000:]})
 if r.returncode!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'{cmd[0]} exited {r.returncode}, expected {expected}: {r.stderr[-1500:]}')
 return r
bootstrap=['uvx','--from',str(args.wheel.resolve()),'amkernel']
install=bootstrap+['install','--client','copilot','--project',str(project),'--scope','project','--yes','--json']
try:
 installed=json.loads(run(install,timeout=300).stdout); assert installed['skill_installed'] and installed['mcp_configured'] and installed['runtime_installed']; evidence['checks'].append('clean-installed-wheel')
 assert not (project/'.git').exists() and not (project/'.venv').exists(); evidence['checks'].append('no-project-git-or-python-environment-mutation')
 manifest_path=project/'.agents/skills/amkernel/references/official-skills.json'; manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
 for rel,digest in manifest['source']['files'].items():
  actual=project/manifest['source']['generatedLocation']/rel; assert actual.is_file() and not actual.is_symlink() and hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
 for item in manifest['installedSkills']:
  for rel,digest in item['files'].items(): assert hashlib.sha256((project/item['generatedLocation']/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
 evidence['checks'].append('complete-pinned-source-and-every-skill-copy')
 run([sys.executable,project/'.agents/skills/amkernel/scripts/verify_official_skills.py','--project-root',project]); evidence['checks'].append('installed-standalone-verifier')
 status=json.loads(run(bootstrap+['doctor','--project',project,'--json']).stdout); assert status['detail'] is None
 home=pathlib.Path(env['COPILOT_HOME']); home.mkdir(); (home/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'trustedFolders':[str(project)]}))
 version=run([args.copilot,'--version']).stdout; assert 'GitHub Copilot CLI' in version
 skills=json.loads(run([args.copilot,'skill','list','--json']).stdout); evidence['nativeSkillDiscovery']=skills
 mcp=json.loads(run([args.copilot,'mcp','get','amkernel','--json']).stdout); evidence['nativeMcpDiscovery']=mcp
 skill_text=json.dumps(skills); assert 'amkernel' in skill_text and all(item['name'] in skill_text for item in manifest['installedSkills'])
 assert '.mcp.json' in json.dumps(mcp); evidence['checks'].append('native-client-skills-and-workspace-mcp-discovery')
 env['COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN']=subprocess.run(['gh','auth','token'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
 nonce=secrets.token_hex(8)
 variable = 'amkernel_install_' + nonce
 first_code = f'{variable} = {{"nonce": {nonce!r}, "value": 41}}'
 second_code = f'import json, os, sys\n{variable}["value"] += 1\nprint(json.dumps({{**{variable}, "interpreter": sys.executable, "cwd": os.getcwd()}}))'
 prompt = 'Use the installed amkernel Skill. Verify this clean external project installation only. Do not start Appium or any device/session, change files or install anything. Execute the following two separate python_exec calls with exactly the supplied code. First:\n```python\n' + first_code + '\n```\nSecond:\n```python\n' + second_code + '\n```\nReport observed namespace persistence.'
 prompt+=' Also load the installed official xcuitest-real-device-config Skill to verify its discovery and reference path only; do not perform device preparation.'
 native, observed, final = run_native(project, args.copilot, prompt, base, env, timeout=240)
 evidence['nativeClient'] = native
 assert native['process']['exitCode'] == 0 and not native['process']['timedOut']
 actual = [call for call in native['calls'] if call.get('mcpToolName') == 'python_exec']
 assert len(actual) >= 2 and all(call.get('mcpConfigSource') == 'workspace' for call in actual)
 assert native['mainSkillLoaded'] and native['observedCompletedAlive']
 assert any(call.get('skill') == 'xcuitest-real-device-config' and call.get('success') for call in native['calls'])
 first_calls = [call for call in actual if call.get('codeSha256') == hashlib.sha256(first_code.encode()).hexdigest()]
 second_calls = [call for call in actual if call.get('codeSha256') == hashlib.sha256(second_code.encode()).hexdigest()]
 assert len(first_calls) == len(second_calls) == 1
 assert first_calls[0]['executionCount'] < second_calls[0]['executionCount']
 evidence['persistenceExecutionCounts'] = [first_calls[0]['executionCount'], second_calls[0]['executionCount']]
 evidence['exactStateOperationsObserved'] = True
 values = []
 for payload in observed:
  if payload.get('executionCount') != second_calls[0]['executionCount']: continue
  for line in payload.get('stdout', '').splitlines():
   try: value = json.loads(line)
   except json.JSONDecodeError: continue
   if isinstance(value, dict): values.append(value)
 assert any(value.get('nonce') == nonce and type(value.get('value')) is int and value['value'] == 42 and value.get('cwd') == str(project.resolve()) and isinstance(value.get('interpreter'), str) and value['interpreter'] for value in values)
 evidence['persistenceObserved'] = True
 evidence['checks'].append('real-native-client-project-skill-and-persistent-python-exec')
 evidence['checks'].append('native-real-device-continuation-skill-loaded')
 # Fail closed on independently corrupted source, then repair through the product installer.
 source_file=project/manifest['source']['generatedLocation']/'LICENSE'; original=source_file.read_bytes(); source_file.write_bytes(original+b'\ntamper\n')
 broken=json.loads(run(bootstrap+['doctor','--project',project,'--json'],expected=1).stdout); assert broken['detail'] and not broken['skill_content_verified']; evidence['checks'].append('source-tamper-fails-closed')
 run(install,timeout=300); assert source_file.read_bytes()==original; evidence['checks'].append('owned-source-repaired-by-installer')
 copy=project/manifest['installedSkills'][0]['generatedLocation']/'SKILL.md'; original=copy.read_bytes(); copy.unlink()
 broken=json.loads(run(bootstrap+['doctor','--project',project,'--json'],expected=1).stdout); assert broken['detail'] and not broken['skill_content_verified']; run(install,timeout=300); assert copy.read_bytes()==original; evidence['checks'].append('missing-official-copy-fails-closed-and-repairs')
 original_project=project
 for case in ('github-only','both-present'):
  project=base/case; project.mkdir(); (project/'.github').mkdir()
  retained={'mcpServers':{'kept':{'type':'stdio','command':sys.executable,'args':['-c','pass']}}}
  active=project/('.github/mcp.json' if case=='github-only' else '.mcp.json')
  active.write_text(json.dumps(retained))
  inactive=project/'.github/mcp.json'
  inactive_bytes=None
  if case=='both-present':
   inactive.write_text(json.dumps({'mcpServers':{'inactive':{'type':'stdio','command':sys.executable,'args':['-c','pass']}}}))
   inactive_bytes=inactive.read_bytes()
  run(bootstrap+['install','--client','copilot','--project',str(project),'--scope','project','--yes','--json'],timeout=300)
  assert json.loads(active.read_text())['mcpServers']['kept']==retained['mcpServers']['kept']
  if inactive_bytes is not None:assert inactive.read_bytes()==inactive_bytes
  else:assert not (project/'.mcp.json').exists()
  (home/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'trustedFolders':[str(original_project),str(project)]}))
  kept=json.loads(run([args.copilot,'--no-auto-update','mcp','get','kept','--json']).stdout)
  managed=json.loads(run([args.copilot,'--no-auto-update','mcp','get','amkernel','--json']).stdout)
  assert 'kept' in json.dumps(kept) and 'amkernel' in json.dumps(managed)
  evidence['checks'].append('native-active-config-coexistence-'+case)
 project=original_project
 (home/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'trustedFolders':[str(project)]}))
 evidence['status']='passed'
except Exception as error:
 evidence['status']='failed'; evidence['error']=str(error)
finally:
 args.output.write_text(scrub(json.dumps(evidence,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False))+'\n')
 print(json.dumps({'status':evidence['status'],'checks':evidence['checks'],'evidence':str(args.output),'base':str(base),'error':evidence.get('error')}),flush=True)
if evidence['status']!='passed':sys.exit(1)

import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from native_evidence import run_native

project = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
output = Path(sys.argv[2])
packages = ['amkernel', 'Appium-Python-Client', 'selenium', 'urllib3', 'packaging']
code = 'import importlib.metadata as md, json\nfacts = {}\nfor name in ' + repr(packages) + ':\n    try:\n        facts[name] = md.version(name)\n    except md.PackageNotFoundError:\n        facts[name] = None\nprint(json.dumps({"packageVersions": facts}))'
environment = dict(os.environ)
environment['COPILOT_HOME'] = str(project.parent / 'copilot')
environment['AMKERNEL_DATA_HOME'] = str(project.parent / 'data')
environment['COPILOT_GITHUB_TOKEN'] = subprocess.run(['gh', 'auth', 'token'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()
prompt = 'Use installed amkernel Skill. Read-only prerequisite discovery after an unsuccessful Mac2 attempt. Do not start a server/session, read desktop contents, install dependencies, or modify any environment or device. Execute exactly this python_exec code and report only its package versions:\n```python\n' + code + '\n```'
native, payloads, _ = run_native(project, Path('/tmp/amkernel-remediation-tools/node_modules/.bin/copilot'), prompt, project.parent, environment, timeout=180)
expected_hash = hashlib.sha256(code.encode()).hexdigest()
counts = {call.get('executionCount') for call in native['calls'] if call.get('mcpToolName') == 'python_exec' and call.get('codeSha256') == expected_hash and call.get('status') == 'completed' and call.get('kernelState') == 'alive'}
facts = None
for payload in payloads:
    if payload.get('executionCount') not in counts:
        continue
    for line in payload.get('stdout', '').splitlines():
        try:
            value = json.loads(line).get('packageVersions')
        except (json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError):
            continue
        if isinstance(value, dict) and set(value) == set(packages) and all(version is None or isinstance(version, str) and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9][A-Za-z0-9.!+_-]{0,80}', version) for version in value.values()):
            facts = value
record = {'scope': 'Read-only package metadata from the actual installed python_exec environment; no installation or platform qualification', 'native': native, 'packageVersions': facts, 'exactProbeObserved': facts is not None}
output.write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'exactProbeObserved': facts is not None, 'packageVersions': facts, 'output': str(output)}))
if facts is None:
    raise SystemExit(1)
